generate_stubs_header: generate a .pyi stub file for the GGML API from a C header file
format_type_decl: format a C type declaration node into a Python type annotation string
visit_func_decl: visit a C function declaration AST node and extract its signature for stub generation
visit_enum_node: visit a C enum AST node and generate property stubs for each enumerator
get_source_snippet_lines: extract comment and declaration lines from the original C source file at a given coordinate
